zoe (new-hire): hey team, first week here — quick q about secrets: who owns rotating service secrets for new services we deploy? do new hires request access somewhere or do infra/storage teams hand keys off?
maya (DevEx): welcome! :tada: short answer: infra owns the KMS keys, DevEx handles Vault policies and onboarding flow.
sam (eng-security): +1. security rotates customer-facing credentials and master KMS keys on a schedule, but service-level API keys are rotated by the owning service team unless covered in the onboarding ticket.
zoe (new-hire): ah ok — what should i include in the onboarding ticket to get a Vault path and KMS key? any example?
maya (DevEx): include: service name, repo + envs (prod/stage/dev), list of secrets (eg DB_PASSWORD, S3_ROLE_ARN), who needs access, and whether it needs cross-account KMS. You can use the template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/templates/secrets-request (or run `onboarding-bot create-secret-request`).
zoe (new-hire): perfect — do we have a standard naming convention for Vault paths?
leo (infra): yes: `kv/data/services/<team>/<service>` for KV v2. KMS keys are provisioned as `projects/redwood/kms/keys/<team>-<service>-key` (internal id). Put the full Vault path & key id in the ticket.
irene (manager): subtle note: for short-lived creds prefer the workload identity / IAM approach and avoid long-lived plain-text secrets. If you need a service account, file the request and we'll provision with least privilege.
zoe (new-hire): who actually performs rotations when something is compromised? is there an SLA?
sam (eng-security): incident rotations are triaged by oncall + owning service. For vault-stored secrets we rotate creds, revoke tokens, and create new versions. SLA: sensitive key compromise -> 4h containment target, full rotation depends on downstream services but we try to finish within 24h.
maya (DevEx): for everyday scheduled rotations, infra/kms rotates master keys quarterly, services should rotate their own DB passwords at least every 90 days. We have a one-click rotate job in Console for supported integrations.
zoe (new-hire): ok, how do new hires get Vault dev access? i submitted the google form but not sure next steps.
onboarding-bot: Thanks Zoe! Your secret-access request id `SR-2026-314` has been received. Steps: 1) devex will add you to the `team/<team>-read` Vault role, 2) infra will provision any KMS key access, 3) you must sign the secrets handling checklist. Tracking: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/SR-2026-314
maya (DevEx): checked — I approved and added you to `team/infra-read` for dev envs. You should be able to do `vault kv get kv/data/services/infra/example-service` now. Try `vault login` then `vault kv list kv/metadata/services/infra`.
zoe (new-hire): tried it, i can list but get permission denied for `example-service` itself. do i need additional role?
maya (DevEx): pinged infra to add path write access for your team on that specific service (they often lock example services). @leo can you grant `team/infra-dev` read to that path?
leo (infra): done — gave `team/infra-dev` read on `kv/data/services/infra/example-service` and added you to the ACL. try again.
zoe (new-hire): works now, thanks! last Q: if i need to rotate a DB password for my feature branch, any recommended quick flow?
maya (DevEx): for feature-branch-level creds use ephemeral tokens or create a branch-scoped secret with short TTL via `vault token create -policy=feature-<id> -ttl=8h` or use our ephemeral DB creds plugin: `devex db-ephemeral create --service example-service --ttl 4h`. Avoid committing creds.
sam (eng-security): also file a follow-up ticket if the rotation affects prod. we keep an audit log for all rotations.
zoe (new-hire): awesome — this helps a ton. thanks everyone :pray:
irene (manager): welcome again! ping me or maya if anything else blocks your stack setup.
maya (DevEx): adding links: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets-onboarding, rotation playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rotation, and a short checklist:
```
- create secrets-request ticket
- add team membership in vault
- provision kms key (if cross-account)
- test read/get in non-prod
- schedule rotation & document owner
```
zoe (new-hire): saved — appreciate the quick help.
